sources.observation: Balconies and four domed corner turrets surround the narrower round crown. Wide arches face the plaza below the tall window bays.

limitations: The 95 m architectural height follows Montevideo’s municipal listing. The map’s 105 m upper tag and the photographed architectural crown give different overall heights. Small ornament is modeled in simplified relief.
